title: Representation World Model: Learning States, Transition and Executable Plans in Representation
abstract: We propose the Representation World Model (RWM), which learns states, transitions, and executable plans directly in representation space. Unlike existing world models that typically learn latent representations together with explicit dynamics models and perform planning through search, optimization, or policy-based prediction, RWM directly incorporates planning into the learned representation geometry. RWM learns the representation geometry by applying inverse-dynamics supervision locally along latent paths constructed from endpoint representations, requiring these paths to preserve task-relevant state and transition information. At inference, planning is performed by directly constructing a latent path between the current and goal representations, with inverse dynamics used to recover the corresponding actions, without recursive rollouts or action-space search. Experiments on continuous-control benchmarks demonstrate the effectiveness of RWM for direct planning, while results on robotic manipulation further show its potential to extend to more complex embodied control tasks. These results suggest that planning directly in representation space provides a promising alternative to conventional world-model planning.

segments.speaker: John
segments.en: In Deep Reinforcement Learning Methods, today's lecture is on the Representation World Model, or R-W-M. Recent work such as LeWorldModel learns latent predictive dynamics, while Temporal Straightening explores how latent geometry can support planning. The broader direction is toward representations that help agents act, but many model-based systems still search through imagined action sequences. R-W-M takes a different route: it makes a constructed path between current and goal representations directly decodable into actions. I see your hand, Noah.
segments.zh: 在深度强化学习方法这门课里，今天讲的是表征世界模型，也就是R-W-M。最近的一些工作，比如LeWorldModel，学习的是潜在预测动态，而Temporal Straightening则探索潜在几何如何支持规划。更大的方向是走向能帮助智能体行动的表示，但很多基于模型的系统仍然要在想象出来的动作序列里做搜索。R-W-M走了一条不同的路：它把当前表示和目标表示之间构造出的路径，直接解码成动作。我看到你举手了，Noah。

segments.speaker: Noah
segments.en: Hi Professor, if a model can predict possible futures, why isn’t that already enough to reach a goal?
segments.zh: 教授您好，如果一个模型能预测可能的未来，为什么这还不足以达成目标呢？

segments.speaker: John
segments.en: Prediction alone does not specify which actions will reliably move an agent toward its target. A conventional planner may generate candidate action sequences, predict their outcomes, and search for a promising sequence. That can work, but it creates an online planning problem. R-W-M instead uses the current and goal observations to define a path in latent space, then learns how to turn local steps along that path into actions. The distinction matters for visual control, where an agent must act on its representation, not merely describe it.
segments.zh: 仅仅预测并不能指明哪些动作能可靠地把智能体推向目标。传统规划器可能会生成候选动作序列，预测它们的结果，然后搜索出一条有希望的序列。这确实可行，但会带来一个在线规划问题。R-W-M 则不同，它用当前观测和目标观测在潜空间中定义一条路径，然后学习如何把这条路径上的局部步骤转化为动作。这一区别在视觉控制中很关键，因为智能体必须基于自己的表征去行动，而不只是描述它。

segments.speaker: John
segments.en: Here is the training idea. The model encodes two observations from the same action-labeled trajectory, such as the beginning and end of a segment. It then places evenly spaced intermediate representations between those endpoint codes. Those points are a geometric construction, not a guarantee that the corresponding transitions are physically valid. The method therefore needs a learning signal that connects each neighboring pair of representations to an action demonstrated in the trajectory.
segments.zh: 训练思路是这样的。模型先把同一条带动作标注的轨迹里的两个观测编码，比如一段轨迹的起点和终点。然后在这两个端点编码之间，均匀地插入一些中间表示。这些点只是几何构造出来的，并不保证对应的状态转移在物理上真的成立。所以这个方法还需要一个学习信号，把每一对相邻表示和轨迹中实际执行过的动作对应起来。

segments.speaker: Noah
segments.en: Quick question: how does the model know which action belongs to an interpolated pair?
segments.zh: 快速问一下：模型怎么知道哪个动作属于插值出来的一对？

segments.speaker: John
segments.en: It trains a shared inverse-dynamics model, or I-D-M, to predict the action from two neighboring representations. The demonstrated actions supervise transitions along the constructed path. Because the intermediate codes depend on the endpoint encodings, this objective also shapes the representations and the geometry between them. In effect, the model is not told that every straight line is a valid route; it is trained to make local sections of its constructed route support recovery of the demonstrated actions.
segments.zh: 它训练一个共享的逆动力学模型，也就是I-D-M，根据两个相邻表示来预测动作。演示动作则用来监督沿构造路径的各个转移。由于中间编码依赖于两端点的编码，这个目标也会塑造表示本身以及它们之间的几何结构。实际上，模型并不是被告知每条直线都是有效路线，而是被训练成让它所构造路线的局部片段能够支持对演示动作的恢复。

segments.speaker: John
segments.en: At standard inference, when the goal observation is available, R-W-M encodes the current and goal observations, constructs intermediate codes between them, and applies the I-D-M to neighboring pairs to produce actions. It can decode those actions in parallel for open-loop execution. For closed-loop control, it can re-encode after an action chunk and reconstruct a path toward the goal. In this procedure, search-free means no recursive forward-model rollouts or action-space search are required; it does not mean proven faster wall-clock inference.
segments.zh: 在标准推理阶段，当目标观测可用时，R-W-M会编码当前观测和目标观测，在两者之间构造中间编码，并对相邻编码对应用I-D-M来生成动作。它可以并行解码这些动作，用于开环执行。对于闭环控制，它可以在执行一段动作后重新编码，并重建一条通往目标的路径。在这个过程中，无搜索指的是不需要递归的前向模型轨迹或动作空间搜索；这并不意味着已经证明其实际推理速度更快。

segments.speaker: John
segments.en: The objective ablation tests whether action supervision along the constructed path matters. On PushT, the full objective reaches 96% success. Removing interpolation-based I-D-M supervision and keeping only the auxiliary encoded-state I-D-M and consistency terms lowers success to 39.37%. Tested variants that retain the interpolation term score from 95.23% to 96.17%. These ablations use training seed 3072, so they support the importance of the path-action loss on this task, not a claim that it is the only cause of success.
segments.zh: 目标消融实验检验的是，沿构建路径施加动作监督是否重要。在 PushT 上，完整目标能达到 96% 的成功率。去掉基于插值的 I-D-M 监督，只保留辅助的编码状态 I-D-M 和一致性项后，成功率降到 39.37%。而保留插值项的测试变体得分在 95.23% 到 96.17% 之间。这些消融实验用的是训练种子 3072，所以它们支持路径-动作损失在这个任务上的重要性，并不代表它是成功的唯一原因。

segments.speaker: Noah
segments.en: So the ablation suggests that interpolation alone is not doing the work; action grounding is essential?
segments.zh: 所以这个消融实验说明，光靠插值本身起不了作用，动作接地才是关键？

segments.speaker: John
segments.en: That is the supported interpretation, with an important qualification: the comparison is on one task and one ablation setup. Across four tasks, R-W-M reports a macro success rate of 98.25%, the unweighted mean of its PushT, Cube, Reacher, and TwoRoom rates: 95.44%, 100%, 97.89%, and 99.67%. The published INTACT goal-conditioned I-D-M reference has a 95.33% macro. Table 1 labels published rows as external references, not paired controls, so this is a reported comparison, not a paired causal test.
segments.zh: 这是有依据的解读，但有一个重要的限定：这个比较只基于一个任务和一套消融实验设置。在四个任务上，R-W-M 报告的宏平均成功率为 98.25%，即 PushT、Cube、Reacher 和 TwoRoom 四个任务成功率的未加权平均值：95.44%、100%、97.89% 和 99.67%。已发表的 INTACT 目标条件 I-D-M 参考的宏平均为 95.33%。表 1 将已发表的行标注为外部参考，而非配对对照，因此这是一个报告中的比较，不是配对因果检验。

segments.speaker: Noah
segments.en: Another question: does the same goal-to-goal path work when the robot never sees the goal observation?
segments.zh: 还有一个问题：如果机器人从头到尾都没见过目标观测，那同一条从目标到目标的路径还管用吗？

segments.speaker: John
segments.en: Not unchanged. LIBERO-Goal is a separate, goal-unobserved setting. There, R-W-M adds a latent-delta predictor that iteratively proposes displacements rather than constructing a path from an encoded goal. It reports 93% mean success with a 0.03 billion parameter model, compared with 71.2% for LeWorldModel plus an O-F-T head and 81.2% for R-C-aux plus an O-F-T head, both 0.07 billion. OpenVLA-OFT reports 97% at 7 billion parameters, an external reference rather than a same-scale comparison.
segments.zh: 并非没有变化。LIBERO-Goal 是一个独立的、目标不可观测的设定。在那里，R-W-M 增加了一个潜在增量预测器，它迭代地提出位移，而不是从编码的目标构建路径。它报告了 93% 的平均成功率，模型参数量为 0.03 亿，相比之下，LeWorldModel 加上 O-F-T 头为 71.2%，R-C-aux 加上 O-F-T 头为 81.2%，两者均为 0.07 亿参数。OpenVLA-OFT 在 70 亿参数下报告了 97%，这是一个外部参考，而非同等规模的比较。

segments.speaker: John
segments.en: The contrast with prior work clarifies the contribution. LeWorldModel learns action-conditioned latent forward dynamics and uses cross-entropy method search over rollouts. INTACT’s goal-conditioned inverse-dynamics model directly maps current and goal representations to actions. R-W-M is closer to direct control than to rollout-based search, but it adds intermediate representations and decodes neighboring transitions along them. This makes the comparison with INTACT especially relevant, while the external-reference status of the published table rows limits what we can infer from the numerical gap.
segments.zh: 与先前工作的对比更能说明这项贡献。LeWorldModel 学习以动作为条件的潜在前向动力学，并在轨迹上用交叉熵方法做搜索。INTACT 的目标条件逆动力学模型则直接把当前表示和目标表示映射为动作。R-W-M 更接近直接控制，而不是基于轨迹的搜索，但它加入了中间表示，并沿着这些表示解码相邻的转移。这使得与 INTACT 的对比尤其有意义，而已发表表格中那些行属于外部参照，这限制了我们能从数值差距中推断出的结论。

segments.speaker: Noah
segments.en: How should we interpret the efficiency claim, then, without comparable timing measurements?
segments.zh: 那么，在没有可比计时数据的情况下，我们该如何理解这个效率主张呢？

segments.speaker: John
segments.en: Precisely and narrowly: the standard inference procedure avoids recursive forward-model rollouts and action-space search. The paper does not establish faster elapsed inference, fewer training attempts, or lower total computation. That distinction matters as the field explores latent planning, including work such as AdaJEPA and LeWorldModel, because avoiding one online search procedure is not the same as eliminating planning costs. Future evaluations could measure wall-clock performance and compare methods under matched controls while testing when constructed latent paths remain useful.
segments.zh: 准确而严格地说：标准的推理过程避免了递归的前向模型轨迹和动作空间搜索。这篇论文并没有证明推理耗时更短、训练尝试次数更少，或总计算量更低。这一区分很重要，因为该领域正在探索潜在规划，包括AdaJEPA和LeWorldModel等工作，原因在于避免某一种在线搜索过程并不等于消除了规划成本。未来的评估可以测量实际运行时间，并在匹配控制条件下比较不同方法，同时测试构造出的潜在路径何时仍然有用。

segments.speaker: John
segments.en: The central lesson is that a geometric path becomes useful for control only when the representation and its intermediate regions are trained to support local action recovery. The ablation connects that mechanism to the reported search-free benchmark results, while leaving open questions about generalization and computational tradeoffs. R-W-M shifts attention from searching through imagined actions toward learning planning structure in the representation itself. Its claim is not that interpolation always creates a physically valid route, but that action supervision can make a constructed route executable. Thanks for listening. If you have any further questions, ask our AI assistant or drop a comment.
segments.zh: 核心结论是，一条几何路径只有在表征及其中间区域经过训练、能够支持局部动作恢复时，才会对控制有用。消融实验把这一机制与论文报告的免搜索基准结果联系了起来，同时留下了关于泛化和计算权衡的开放问题。R-W-M把注意力从在想象动作中搜索，转向在表征本身中学习规划结构。它并不是说插值总能生成物理上可行的路径，而是说动作监督可以让一条构造出来的路径变得可执行。感谢收听。如果还有问题，可以问我们的AI助手，或者留言评论。
